name: Menu Curator
description: Curate the Plugins section of the Jellyfin dashboard menu. Hide pages you do not use, add pages that their plugins leave out of the menu, and change each entry's name, icon and position. Changes apply to the dashboard for every administrator.
overview: Choose which plugin pages appear in the dashboard menu

versions.changelog: Reset the menu from the settings page or the new "Reset dashboard menu" scheduled task. The menu now returns to normal as soon as Menu Curator is uninstalled.
First release. Show or hide plugin pages in the dashboard menu, add pages their plugins leave out, and set each entry's name, icon and order from a settings page.
